podcoupling.help: Electronic coupling between two covalently bonded fragments of one converged ground-state DFT calculation, by projection-operator diabatization (POD2): each fragment's Fock sub-block is diagonalized separately and the coupling is read from the off-diagonal block, with the Lowdin correction for the overlap of the two fragment orbitals (as in DIPRO, Baumeier et al., PCCP 12, 11103 (2010)). For non-bonded fragments use the coupling tool (DIPRO).

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for intermediate files

orb_file.help: Converged ground-state DFT calculation (orb file) of the bonded supermolecule

fragment_A.help: Atom indices (0-based) of fragment A, e.g. '0:5' or '0 1 2 3 4 5' (same syntax as cdft.indices)

fragment_B.help: Atom indices (0-based) of fragment B, disjoint from fragment_A

levA.help: Number of occupied and of virtual orbitals of fragment A, counted from the HOMO/LUMO gap (as levA of the coupling tool): 1 covers HOMO and LUMO, 2 covers HOMO-1 to LUMO+1, etc.

write_cube_files.help: Write a cube file for each fragment orbital covered by levA/levB

xsteps.help: Grid points in x for the cube files (as in gencube)

ysteps.help: Grid points in y for the cube files (as in gencube)

zsteps.help: Grid points in z for the cube files (as in gencube)

padding.help: Distance of the cube grid from the molecule (as in gencube)
